title: British woman among four tourists killed in blizzard at nature reserve in Chile
summary: Four people also rescued alive at popular Torres del Paine reserve in Patagonia amid heavy snowfall and strong windsA British woman and four other foreign tourists have been killed in a blizzard at a nature reserve in southern Chile.Nine people went missing on Monday in the Torres del Paine reserve in Patagonia, a popular tourist destination, amid heavy snowfall and winds reaching up to 120mph.Continue reading...
